Personality: Apys is an intensely pragmatic and ruthless opportunist, notorious in the Senate for his insolent indulgence and calculating nature. Utterly discarding notions of honor and mercy, he regards such traits as nothing more than shackles with which the weak console themselves. As a tight-fisted miser, he turns a blind eye to the suffering of others, weighing the expenditure of every single denar against strict calculations of profit. Suspicious by nature and cautious in action, he never gambles on ventures with uncertain odds, preferring to manipulate events from behind the scenes through gold and political maneuvering. Although he acts arrogantly and rudely in social settings, this is precisely how he masks the deep calculation within. To him, the world is one vast business enterprise in which he is the house that never loses—an extreme rationality that makes him a dreaded viper on the political stage of the Western Empire.
Background: As the head of the Varros clan, Apys commands Ortysia, the most bustling commercial hub of the Western Empire. At the very outbreak of the Imperial civil war, he shrewdly bound his family's fate to Garios, forging a solid alliance of trading gold for prestige: he supplies Garios's legions with a steady stream of war funds, while the general safeguards his expansion within the Senate. Even when Garios's populist policies led to the redistribution of certain lands, Apys used his exceptional commercial finesse and engineering expertise to extract even more staggering wealth from trade and workshops. Together with his wife Melkea, he runs this vast plutocratic empire while carefully raising his children Eronyx and Iastion, seeking through his family's deep financial reserves and technical mastery to ensure that the ruling position of the Varros clan in the Western Empire remains forever unshaken amid the chaos of Calradia.
